text:
noah (Design): quick sync 1 preflight layout + copy. users hesitated when the wizard blocked them with a big connectivity step. thinking of a lighter pattern + clearer privacy line.

eva (UX): agree. idea: tiny prereq banner at top + an inline, collapsed "Connectivity" row. expand to run checks. keeps flow but makes checks discoverable.

sam (Eng): technical: probe does a simple TCP handshake, optional SSH ping on 22, and HTTP GET if port set. originates from stable IPv4 IPs. no auth or commands run. we can provide a signed download script for offline checks.

noah (Design): microcopy suggestion under the row: "Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from its health-checker IPs to the host and port you supply. No credentials are sent. See privacy details." short and explicit.

monica (Product): policy: default ON for hosted, OFF for private. CTA ordering: for hosted primary = "Run from Redwood", secondary = "Download local probe". reverse for private. document this in the spec.

eva (UX): ARIA: make the toggle have aria-describedby that contains the full sentence above. when checks run, announce "Connectivity checks running" via polite live region; final announce should include next step. on fail, move focus to failing chip and announce reason.

sam (Eng): we'll return `probe_summary` items (label, status, reason) and `probe_logs_url`. note: logs may include target host and probe IPs; we'll redact any token-like strings. local script will only upload handshake results.

accessibility-bot: reminder: use role=status for live updates and ensure error links are keyboard focusable. :white_check_mark: 

noah (Design): perfect. i'll mock the compact row + banner + chips. eva i'll ping you for ARIA wording. monica i'll update the spec with default states and CTA ordering.

monica (Product): thanks all 1 i'll add the privacy blurb link to the doc and pick up any open decisions after the mock.
